**The opportunity**

**GOV :**
 Our Global Government \& Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best\-in\-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.

**SaT :**
 The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government \& Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
   

  

 The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sector’s diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.

BIM Structural Project Delivery Head (PDH)
description:
**About Intelligent Consulting Engineers (ICE):** 

 Founded in 2015, Intelligent Consulting Engineers (ICE) is an independent BIM and Engineering consultancy (MNC) based in Finland, India, North America, and Estonia delivering services all over the world. Our geographic footprint stretches across more than 15 countries in Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia with a collective experience of more than 500 projects. Our teams excels in engineering experiences through Building Information Modelling (BIM), continually redefining industry standards. Committed to a collaborative and growth\-oriented workplace, ICE offers opportunities for professionals to contribute to pioneering projects, influence the future of construction, and advance their careers within a company dedicated to excellence and technological leadership.
 





  
 




**Website Link:** 

 https://icengg.com/
 




  





**BIM Structural Project Delivery Head (PDH)** 




**Location:** 
 New Town, Kolkata
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 Days a week.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced BIM Structural Project Delivery Head (PDH) to lead structural BIM project delivery, manage teams, and drive projects from planning through successful completion.The ideal candidate should bring strong experience in Structural BIM, project delivery, team leadership, client coordination, and project execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end Structural BIM project delivery and ensure timely, high\-quality deliverables.
* Manage, mentor, and develop BIM Structural teams.
* Plan resources, monitor project schedules, productivity, quality, and overall delivery performance.
* Oversee BIM modelling, coordination, detailing, clash resolution, and model quality.
* Coordinate with clients and internal stakeholders to address technical and project\-related challenges.
* Identify project risks and implement effective solutions to keep delivery on track.
* Drive BIM standards, workflows, process improvements, and delivery excellence.



  





**Requirements** 



* Minimum 12\+ years of experience in Structural BIM and Project Delivery.
* B.Tech in Civil Engineering / Structural Engineering – Mandatory.
* Strong experience in Structural BIM and Project Delivery.
* Proven experience in leading BIM Structural teams and managing projects.
* Strong understanding of BIM processes, structural modelling, coordination, and detailing.
* Excellent leadership, client communication, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.
* Precast experience will be an added advantage.
* Tekla experience will be an added advantage.
* Civil 3D experience will be an added advantage.

title: Senior Project Coordinator
description:
Job Description \- Senior C\&I; /Senior Project Coordinator
 



 Project: Corporate Interior Design / Fit\-out Projects
 



 Locations: Kolkata
 



 Experience: Minimum 10\+ years
 



 Deployment: Full\-time at Project Site
 



 Role Summary
 



 RSP is looking for an experienced Interior Site Coordinator to represent the design team at site for large\-scale
 



 Accenture corporate interior projects. The candidate will act as the key interface between the RSP design team,
 



 Client, PMC, contractors, vendors and other consultants, ensuring that the approved design intent is correctly
 



 translated and implemented at site.
 



 The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in corporate workplace interior projects and be capable of
 



 independently handling design coordination, site queries, shop drawings, approvals and execution\-related design
 



 issues.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Represent the RSP Interior Design team at site and manage day\-to\-day design coordination.
 



 • Review site execution against approved GFC drawings, specifications and design intent.
 



 • Coordinate with Client, PMC, contractors, vendors, MEP consultants and the RSP design team.
 



 • Review and coordinate interior shop drawings including partitions, ceilings, flooring, wall finishes, doors, joinery,
 



 furniture and other interior elements.
 



 • Review site conditions and identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions.
 



 • Coordinate architectural/interior works with MEP services and resolve interface and ceiling coordination issues.
 



 • Track and facilitate timely closure of RFIs, shop drawings, material submissions, samples and design\-related
 



 approvals.
 



 • Review material and finish samples, mock\-ups and installations for compliance with approved design intent.
 



 • Conduct regular site walks and identify deviations from approved drawings and design requirements.
 



 • Coordinate critical dimensions, setting\-out requirements and site measurements affecting the design.
 



 • Attend project/site coordination meetings and provide design\-related inputs and clarifications.
 



 • Identify potential design and coordination issues in advance and escalate them to the appropriate design/project
 



 teams for timely resolution.
 



 • Coordinate with the RSP design team for required drawing revisions, details and site clarifications.
 



 • Maintain proper records of RFIs, shop drawings, design changes, approvals and site observations.
 



 • Monitor closure of design\-related site observations and snags.
 



 • Provide regular progress and issue updates to the RSP Project/Design Manager.
 



 • Ensure that the overall design intent, quality and detailing standards are maintained throughout execution.
 



 Qualification \& Experience
 



 • Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Architecture, Interior Design or Civil Engineering.
 



 • Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, with substantial experience in corporate
 



 workplace/interior fit\-out projects.
 



 RSP Design Consultants (India) Pvt Ltd \- Accenture Project Page 2
 



 • Strong knowledge of corporate interior construction, detailing, materials, finishes, joinery and fit\-out
 



 methodology.
 



 • Proven experience in coordinating large and fast\-track corporate interior projects.
 



 • Strong ability to read and interpret architectural, interior, shop and MEP drawings.
 



 • Good understanding of MEP interfaces within interior fit\-out projects.
 



 • Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Office; working knowledge of Revit/BIM will be an advantage.
 



 • Strong communication, coordination, documentation and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Ability to independently represent the Design Consultant at site and coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
 



 Preferred Profile
 



 Candidates with previous experience in large corporate workplace projects for multinational clients,
 



 particularly projects involving multiple consultants, PMCs, contractors and specialist vendors, will be preferred.

title: Site Supervisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Garuda Design Studio is a collaborative practice of designers, architects, engineers, and project managers dedicated to creating thoughtful, functional living spaces. The studio focuses on vernacular contemporary design, blending local character with modern comfort and usability. Projects emphasize purity in design, natural materials, and a strong connection to the surrounding environment. Team members work closely together to deliver spaces that feel cozy, livable, and intentionally crafted. The culture supports creativity, technical excellence, and a commitment to sustainable, people\-centered design.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Site Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, responsible for overseeing day\-to\-day activities at project sites. This position coordinates with designers, architects, engineers, contractors, and vendors to ensure that work is executed according to drawings, specifications, and safety standards. Daily responsibilities include monitoring site progress, managing manpower and resources, maintaining quality control, and documenting work through reports, photographs, and checklists. The Site Supervisor also handles basic issue resolution on site, escalates technical concerns to the design and engineering teams, and supports adherence to timelines and budgets. The role involves regular site inspections, communication with clients or client representatives, and ensuring compliance with local regulations and company procedures.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to supervise construction sites, including monitoring daily activities, coordinating trades, and ensuring adherence to design and technical specifications.
* Strong skills in site planning and organization, including scheduling, resource allocation, and basic project coordination with internal teams and external vendors.
* Working knowledge of construction methods, materials, and finishes relevant to residential and vernacular contemporary designs, with attention to quality and safety.
* Competence in documenting site work through reports, measurements, photographs, and checklists, and maintaining accurate records for project tracking.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills for collaborating with architects, engineers, contractors, and clients, and for resolving routine on\-site issues.
* Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings, and translate plans into clear instructions for site teams.
* Understanding of basic health, safety, and environmental standards applicable to construction sites in the Kolkata metropolitan area.
* Relevant experience as a Site Supervisor or similar role in architecture, interior design, or construction projects; residential or small\-scale projects experience is advantageous.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience may be considered.
* Willingness to work primarily on site, travel between project locations within the metropolitan area, and adapt to changing project demands.
